articles.title: Iran widens Gulf attacks, firing on a US air base in Kuwait and at targets in Bahrain

Saudi Arabia also intercepted a cruise missile fired by Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen, following Saudi-led airstrikes that the Houthis say killed at least 17 people.
